rv.q: This highly anticipated, magically mesmerizing musical adaptation of Sir James M. Barrie’s forgotten play is simply enchanting.
This is a curious and engaging fantasy, by turns whimsical, melancholy, and macabre.
For those willing to venture into mystical territory, Mary Rose is likely to stretch the imagination.
This is far too important a chance to lose.
With too-expository lyrics and music that often trudges along and feels too much like chanting, Mary Rose 's songs, though occasionally excellent, end up weighing the play down.
The acting and singing reign supreme in this musical.
Mary Rose is a very impressive new musical.

cn.t: Black Button Eyes' supernatural musical adaptation of J.M. Barrie's 1920 play earns mostly positive reviews for its atmospheric storytelling and original score, though one critic questions whether the music enhances the ghost story.
